[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for waterproofing and caring for a leather jacket include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Pre-treat stains with a damp cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose a waterproofing method (sprays, waxes, creams, oils).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Test the waterproofing product on a small, inconspicuous area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Apply the waterproofing product using a clean cloth or sponge in a circular motion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Store the jacket in a cool, dry place with good ventilation, avoiding direct sunlight or damp areas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Regularly condition the leather with a leather conditioner using a clean, soft cloth.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use a leather cleaner on the affected area with a soft cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use leather conditioner if scratches or scuffs are not too deep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use rubbing alcohol on a cotton ball for stubborn scratches or scuffs.
